label: From Kalam
value: About 11 km to Matiltan; a non-metalled road that needs a four-wheel-drive vehicle
quote: accessible through a non-metalled road from Kalam by a four-wheel drive vehicle

label: The view
value: Falak Sar, the tallest peak of Swat, can be seen from the village
quote: The tallest peak of Swat, Falak Sar can be viewed from it.

label: Ushu valley (not Matiltan)
value: Ushu is a separate place, about 8 km from Kalam and about 2,300 m up
quote: The distance of Ushu from Kalam is roughly 8 km and it is about 2,300 metres (7,550 feet) above sea level.

label: Climate
value: Cold winters and mild summers, with heavy winter snowfall
quote: Ushu Valley has a temperate climate, with cold winters and mild summers.

label: Where to stay
value: Limited accommodation: guest houses, cottages and campsites
quote: You can choose from guest houses, cottages, and campsites.
